card.title: IPhone 15 Pro Max Not Charging and no Touch

source.title: IPhone 15 Pro Max Not Charging and no Touch

claims.statement: iPhone 15 Pro Max no charge (often with no touch) is usually U9500, the chip that detects what's connected to USB-C; if wireless charging works, Tigris is fine.
U9500 needs 5 V at its input with the port connected (board split).
U9500 works with a paired ROM U9720; both must come together from an iPhone 15 Pro Max donor (not 15 or 15 Pro).
A good fast charge reads about 9 V and 2 A+ on a meter.

procedure: Test new display and battery; try wireless charging.
Split the board; check 5 V at U9500 input.
Replace U9500 and U9720 as a pair from a 15 Pro Max donor.
Test on top board alone, then reball and rejoin.
Check 9 V fast charge, data and USB-C audio.
card.caveats: Source also mentions 'ROM IC U1030' once, likely a typo for U9720. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
